Independent Sales Contractor – Automotive Plastic Injection Molding

Job Summary

SyBridgeTechnologies is seeking an experienced Independent Sales Contractor to support business development activities within the Canadian automotive plastic injection molding market.

This opportunity is suited to a well-connected sales professional with established relationships across automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, Tier 2 suppliers, tooling organizations, and plastic injection molding manufacturers. The Independent Sales Contractor will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, expanding market presence, and generating profitable sales opportunities aligned withSyBridgeTechnologies' capabilities.

The successful contractor will bring strong commercial knowledge of the automotive injection molding industry, an understanding of tooling and manufacturing processes, and the ability to independently develop and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

This is an independent contractor engagement and is intended for a self-directed sales professional who can leverage industry knowledge, relationships, and market intelligence to growSyBridgeTechnologies' presence within the Canadian automotive sector.

Key Responsibilities

Identify, develop, and pursue new business opportunities within the Canadian automotive plastic injection molding sector.

Develop relationships with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, Tier 2 suppliers, injection molders, tooling companies, and other relevant industry partners.

Leverage existing industry relationships and develop new contacts to expandSyBridgeTechnologies' customer base.

PromoteSyBridgeTechnologies' plastic injection molding, tooling, engineering, manufacturing, and related capabilities to prospective customers.

Identify customer programs, sourcing opportunities, new platforms, tooling requirements, and production opportunities at early stages of the sales cycle.

Generate qualified leads and maintain an active pipeline of prospective automotive business opportunities.

Coordinate with internal estimating, engineering, operations, program management, and commercial teams to evaluate customer opportunities.

Support the preparation and presentation of proposals, quotations, capability presentations, and customer solutions.

Assist with commercial negotiations related to pricing, scope, timing, tooling, production volumes, and other customer requirements.

Develop a strong understanding of customer needs and recommend solutions aligned withSyBridgeTechnologies' capabilities.

Maintain regular communication with prospective and existing customers throughout the sales process.

Provide market intelligence regarding competitors, customer activity, automotive programs, industry trends, sourcing activity, and emerging opportunities.

Attend customer meetings, industry events, conferences, trade shows, and networking opportunitieswherebeneficial.

Provide accurate sales activity, pipeline, and opportunity updates as required.

Required Qualifications

Five (5) or more years of business development, technical sales, account management, or commercial experience within automotive plastic injection molding, tooling, plastics manufacturing, or a closely related sector.

Established relationships within the Canadian automotive manufacturing industry are strongly preferred.

Strong knowledge of plastic injection molding processes, tooling, mold manufacturing, production requirements, and automotive program lifecycles.

Experience selling to automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, Tier 2 suppliers, or automotive injection molding organizations.

Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads and develop new customer relationships.

Strong understanding of RFQ, quoting, sourcing, and commercial negotiation processes.

Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Ability to understand technical manufacturing requirements and communicate effectively with engineering, tooling, operations, and purchasing professionals.

Strong commercial judgment and ability to identify profitable business opportunities.

Ability to work independently and manage sales activities, customer relationships, and travel requirements.

Ability and willingness to travel throughout Canada and internationally as required.

Existing network within Ontario's automotive manufacturing corridor is considered a strong asset.

Contractor Relationship

This position is structured as an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employer-employee relationship.

The contractor will operate independently in determining their sales approach, customer development strategy, work schedule, and business development activities, subject to agreed commercial objectives and contractual requirements.

Compensation will be based on an agreed commission or sales incentive structure established within the Independent Sales Contractor Agreement.

The contractor is responsible for maintaining appropriate business registrations, insurance, tax remittances, and other obligations associated with operating as an independent contractor.

What We Offer

Competitive commission-based compensation structure

Opportunity to represent an established global manufacturing organization

Access to broad tooling, engineering, injection molding, and manufacturing capabilities

Commercial and technical support for qualified opportunities

Opportunity to develop business across an extensive North American manufacturing network

Corporate Profile

SyBridgeTechnologies is at the forefront of technology-enabled design, prototyping, and manufacturing solutions for complex, high-precision parts. Our mission is to revolutionize how parts are designed and manufactured, making the process simpler and faster through advanced technology. As North America's largest injection molding tooling platform and the leading private on-demand digital manufacturer, we're driven by our cutting-edge AI/ML technology and a team of top-tier software engineers, computational geometry experts, and data scientists.

Backed by Crestview Partners and built through strategic acquisitions,SyBridgeTechnologies serves customers across automotive, mobility, consumer, industrial, healthcare, packaging, and other advanced manufacturing markets.

Discover more at.

Salary: Commission Based, DOE

Position: Automotive Sales Support & Lead Qualification Specialist

Salary: Php 45,000 - 60,000 (Negotiable)

Working Hours & Conditions: Availability during New Zealand business hours required
Employment Arrangement: Independent Contractor Arrangement

Holidays: TBC

About the Company:

The client is a New Zealand business specialising in vehicle auctions and importing. The company is seeking an automotive sales professional to respond to inbound enquiries, help customers find suitable vehicles and support the owners with appointments and sales activity.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The Automotive Sales Support & Lead Qualification Specialist will manage inbound leads and help move prospective buyers through the vehicle enquiry process. This includes understanding what each customer is looking for, sharing relevant vehicle information and following up to progress the opportunity.

At times, the successful candidate will manage the full sales cycle. When the owners are in New Zealand, the candidate will also qualify leads and arrange appointments for them to meet with prospective customers.

Previous experience in the automotive sector is essential. Experience in a dealership sales support, japanese car importing or similar role is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Inbound Enquiries & Lead Qualification

  • Answer inbound calls and respond to customer enquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Understand each customer’s vehicle preferences, budget, timing and requirements.
  • Qualify leads and record relevant information accurately.
  • Match prospective buyers with suitable vehicles or auction opportunities.
  • Send customers relevant vehicle details, listings, photographs and other approved information.
  • Follow up enquiries and keep customers informed as the process progresses.

Sales Support & Customer Follow-Up

  • Guide customers through the vehicle enquiry and purchase process.
  • Explain available vehicle information and the steps involved in purchasing or importing, using approved company information.
  • Respond to routine questions and refer technical or specialist queries to the owners.
  • Maintain regular, helpful follow-up with prospective customers.
  • Support the full sales cycle when assigned, from initial enquiry through to sale.
  • Work within approved pricing, terms and sales procedures.

Appointment Coordination

  • Identify leads that are ready to speak with an owner.
  • Coordinate and book customer appointments when the owners are in New Zealand.
  • Confirm appointment details with both customers and owners.
  • Keep track of appointments, follow-up actions and customer outcomes.

CRM & Lead Management

  • Maintain accurate lead and customer records in the company’s chosen system.
  • Record calls, customer requirements, vehicle interests and agreed next steps.
  • Keep lead statuses and follow-up tasks up to date.
  • Ensure no qualified enquiry is missed or left without an agreed next action.
  • Provide regular updates to the owners on lead activity and sales progress.

Requirements

Key Requirements

  • Previous experience in the automotive sector is essential.
  • Experience in a dealership sales support, vehicle sales or customer enquiry role is strongly preferred.
  • Confident and professional telephone manner.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Ability to understand customer needs and ask effective qualifying questions.
  • Strong follow-up, organisation and record-keeping skills.
  • Comfortable handling sales conversations and progressing leads towards a decision.
  • Reliable, proactive and able to work independently.
  • Confidence learning and using CRM and communication systems.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience with vehicle sales, car dealerships, auctions or vehicle imports.
  • Familiarity with Japanese vehicle auctions or the vehicle importing process.
  • Experience managing inbound leads through to sale.
  • Experience coordinating appointments for business owners or sales team

Benefits

  • New Zealand Working Hours
  • Remote Setup

In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.

About Aeris Communications Inc.

Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices. It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30+ mobile network operators. Enterprises rely on Aeris for the borderless connectivity, embedded security, observability, and proven scale that mission critical Physical AI programs demand.

The Opportunity

The Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive Connectivity is a strategic technical role at the intersection of automotive engineering, telecommunications, cloud platforms, and IoT. You will serve as the primary technical counterpart to automotive OEM engineering and IT teams, translating Aeris platform capabilities into compelling, architecturally sound solutions that address OEM connectivity challenges.

This is not a traditional pre-sales engineering role. You will operate as a technical strategist — shaping how Aeris engages with OEMs, influencing product direction, creating differentiated technical narratives, and building the technical foundation for long-term OEM partnerships.

You will work across two Aeris business units (Automotive Business Unit and IoT Business Unit), requiring fluency in multiple platform architectures and the ability to compose cross-platform solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales Engagement

  • Serve as the lead technical resource in OEM pre-sales engagements, RFI/RFP responses, solution presentations, and architecture workshops
  • Design and present solution architectures that map Aeris capabilities to OEM connectivity requirements
  • Develop and deliver compelling technical demonstrations, proofs of concept, and pilot designs
  • Engage directly with OEM technical stakeholders including connectivity architects, telematics engineers, platform engineering leads, cybersecurity teams, and procurement

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Architect end-to-end connected vehicle solutions spanning connectivity management, eSIM lifecycle management (SGP.22/SGP.32), device management, data ingestion, and vehicle operations
  • Design integration architectures connecting Aeris platforms (AMP, Neo, Watchtower) with OEM backend systems, TSPs, MNOs, and cloud environments
  • Define and document technical solution proposals, integration specifications, and architecture decision records
  • Evaluate and recommend approaches for multi-MNO strategies, regional connectivity models, and roaming optimization

Product Strategy Support

  • Translate OEM technical requirements and competitive gaps into structured product requirements and recommendations
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prioritize automotive-specific platform enhancements
  • Maintain a living competitive technical analysis covering key competitors (Harman Ignite, Ericsson, Cisco/Kigen, G+D, Thales, etc.)
  • Identify emerging technology trends (SDV, vehicle-to-cloud, Android Automotive, zonal architectures) and assess implications for Aeris product strategy

Knowledge Development & Enablement

  • Develop and maintain a technical knowledge base for Automotive Connectivity including solution architectures, reference designs, integration patterns, competitive comparisons, and technical FAQ
  • Create reusable technical assets: solution briefs, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, white papers, and technical blog content
  • Enable broader Sales and Sales Engineering teams on automotive connectivity concepts, Aeris differentiators, and OEM engagement best practices
  • Document OEM-specific technical landscapes, integration requirements, and architecture preferences

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Service Delivery and Professional Services teams to ensure solution designs are implementable and supportable
  • Partner with the Automotive Connectivity Strategy Lead to align technical positioning with business strategy
  • Support Marketing with technically grounded content for thought leadership, analyst engagements, and conference presentations
  • Participate in industry standards discussions and working groups as appropriate (GSMA, 5GAA, etc.)

Requirements

Experience

  • Senior experience in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, systems engineering, or technical consulting
  • 3+ years working in or with the automotive industry — specifically connected vehicles, telematics, V2X, or automotive connectivity

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

As Sr. Manager, Professional Services Consulting (Dealer Variable & Fixed Operations), you will lead a team of customer-facing consultants focused on measuring, managing, and improving outcomes inside automotive dealerships. Your team will help dealers implement and maximize the value of Solera SaaS products and consulting programs by turning data into a clear operating rhythm — diagnose performance, take action, and solidify improvements month after month.

This role blends people leadership, operational execution, and KPI ownership, with a primary focus on managing consultants responsible for helping dealers drive Variable and Fixed Operationsperformance —including lead-to-appointment effectiveness, appointment-to-sale conversion, pipeline discipline, SaaS product adoption, inventory acquisition workflows, executive visibility into sales performance— including performance management frameworks for General Managers, General Sales Managers, Used Car Managers, New Car Managers, Group Operations Directors, c-suite executives, etc.; accountability systems that improve customer pay and warranty workflows, service lane effectiveness, technician productivity—including performance management frameworks for Service Advisors, BDC, and Parts teams, etc.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Consulting Team

Manage, coach, and develop a team of consultants to consistently deliver high-quality engagements that improve dealership sales performance and outcomes.

Set clear expectations, reinforce “One Team” behaviors, and model the professionalism and ethical conduct required for customer-facing leadership.

Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement to build deep product expertise and strong consulting fundamentals across the team.

Measure and Manage Variable and Fixed Ops Outcomes

  • Establish a KPI-based execution cadence with each dealership that ties consulting activity to measurable improvements in variable and fixed operations performance.
  • Drive accountability systems that improve areas such as: lead handling performance, appointment performance, manager enforcement playbooks, etc.Lead the team in strengthening pipeline discipline, coaching opportunities, and cross-department handoffs tied to KPIs that influence sales conversion and profitability.
  • Lead the team in strengthening operational discipline across the service lifecycle—from appointment scheduling and write-up quality to repair order (RO) management, parts availability, and post-service customer follow-up—ensuring consistency and profitability at every stage.

Examples of outcome areas (Variable Ops): sales funnel response quality, lead response speed, appointment set/show rates, close-rate trends, pipeline management, sales/BDC accountability, marketing spend ROI, trade and purchase appraisal close rates, etc.

Examples of outcome areas (Fixed Ops):service appointment utilization, show rates, effective labor rate (ELR), hours per RO, technician efficiency and proficiency, service drive conversion rates, parts gross profit, inventory obsolescence, and customer retention/service revisit rates.

Operational Excellence and Delivery Quality

Own team planning and execution—ensuring the right coverage, prioritization, and consistency across consulting engagements (virtual and onsite as needed).

Build and refine playbooks, templates, and standard methodologies that help consultants deliver repeatable performance improvements while still tailoring to dealership needs.

Monitor and improve delivery quality through structured inspections (e.g., ride-alongs, call reviews, engagement retrospectives) and targeted coaching plans.

Data-Driven Leadership and KPI Ownership

Track and manage team KPIs and dealership performance outcomes; use trends to coach improvements and provide leadership updates.

Ensure consultants translate dealership and platform data into practical actions—such as CRM data integrity and user behavior audits, executive dashboards, custom KPI tracking, and trend analysis frameworks.

Drive consulting programs that influence sales and inventory economics, including inventory aging strategy, appraisal win-rate accountability, and trade acquisition workflows (as applicable to dealership objectives and Solera solutions).

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Stakeholder Influence

Partner closely with Sales, Account Management / Customer Success, Support, and Product teams to align priorities, share learnings from the field, and improve the customer journey.

Lead execution of departmental and company initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and clear communication across stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Expertise: Strong automotive dealership experience highly preferred; ability to “speak the dealership language” and coach others to care about what our dealers care about.
  • Performance Consulting Leadership: Experience leading teams that drive adoption, ROI, and measurable outcomes through structured KPI management and execution cadence.
  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop high-performing teams through clear expectations and consistent accountability.
  • Communication + Presence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident presenting, training, and influencing across frontline to executive stakeholders.
  • Execution + Ownership: Strong personal accountability, operational rigor, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; comfort using data to tell a story and drive action.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel up to 80% to support onsite delivery, key account outcomes, and team development in the field.

Why Join Us?

At Solera, you’ll lead a team that directly impacts dealership success by turning software and data into measurable Variable Ops performance improvements. You’ll help standardize an operating rhythm that converts insight into consistent execution—driving sales outcomes while shaping how Professional Services scales across Vehicle Solutions.
